description_en: Modifies the backup policy of an instance
description_zh: 调用UpdateBackupPolicy接口修改实例备份策略
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx update-backup-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-hzjasdyuoo --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称ID
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. You must specify at least 2 days. The value is a 7-digit number. From left to right, each digit represents whether backup is enabled from Monday to Sunday. A value of 0 indicates that backup is disabled, and a value of 1 indicates that backup is enabled:

First digit: Monday
Second digit: Tuesday
Third digit: Wednesday
Fourth digit: Thursday
Fifth digit: Friday
Sixth digit: Saturday
Seventh digit: Sunday
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期。至少需要指定2天，7位数数值，从左到右每一位数值代表周一到周日是否开启备份。取值0代表不备份，取值1代表备份：

第一位数值：周一
第二位数值：周二
第三位数值：周三
第四位数值：周四
第五位数值：周五
第六位数值：周六
第七位数值：周日
parameters.name: backup_period

parameters.help_en: The daily backup start time in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 每天备份开启时间，UTC时间
parameters.name: backup_plan_begin

parameters.help_en: The retention period of backup sets. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 备份集保留时间，单位天
parameters.name: backup_set_retention

parameters.help_en: The backup type. Currently, only "0" is supported, which indicates fast backup
parameters.help_zh: 备份种类，目前只支持“0”，表示快速备份
parameters.name: backup_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup method. Valid values:

P: physical backup.
L: logical backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份手段，枚举值

P：物理备份
L：逻辑备份
parameters.name: backup_way

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly clean up binary logs when the total space usage of the instance exceeds 80% or the remaining space is less than 50 GB. The cleanup starts from the earliest logs until the total space usage drops below 80% and the remaining space exceeds 50 GB. Valid values:

1: Yes.
0: No
parameters.help_zh:
当实例总空间使用率超过80%或剩余空间不足50 GB时，是否强制清理Binlog。从最早的开始清理，直到总空间使用率降到80%以下且剩余空间大于50 GB。取值如下：

1：是
0：否
parameters.name: force_clean_on_high_space_usage

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable backup. The value is fixed to 1, which indicates that backup is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启备份，固定值1，表示开启
parameters.name: is_enabled

parameters.help_en: The number of hours that log backups are retained locally. Valid values: 0 to 168 (7 × 24 hours). A value of 0 indicates that log backups are not retained locally. Default value: 7
parameters.help_zh: 日志备份本地保留小时数， 范围为0到7×24小时， 0表示不保留，默认7小时
parameters.name: local_log_retention

parameters.help_en: The number of days that log backups are retained remotely. Valid values: 7 to 730. Unit: days. Default value: 7
parameters.help_zh: 日志备份远程保留天数（ 7~730） 单位天， 默认7天
parameters.name: remove_log_retention

parameters.help_en: The maximum binary log space usage in percentage. Valid values: 0 to 50. This parameter specifies a loop space. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 本地日志最大空间使用率，参数大小为0~50，此为循环空间，默认为30
parameters.name: log_local_retention_space

parameters.help_en: The interval of cold data backups. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 59
parameters.help_zh: 冷数据备份间隔天数，取值范围为1~59
parameters.name: cold_data_backup_interval

parameters.help_en: The retention period of cold data backups. Unit: days. Valid values: 30 to 730
parameters.help_zh: 冷数据备份保留天数，取值范围为30~730
parameters.name: cold_data_backup_retention

parameters.help_en: The number of local binary logs to retain. Default value: 60. Valid values: 6 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 本地Binlog保留个数，默认为60，取值范围为6~100
parameters.name: local_log_retention_number

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable cross-region data backup. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启跨地域数据备份，默认为false
parameters.name: is_cross_region_data_backup_enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable cross-region log backup. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启跨地域日志备份，默认为false
parameters.name: is_cross_region_log_backup_enabled

parameters.help_en: The destination region for cross-region backup
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份的目标地域
parameters.name: dest_cross_region

parameters.help_en: The retention period of cross-region data backups. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域数据备份的保存时间，单位：天
parameters.name: cross_region_data_backup_retention

parameters.help_en: The retention period of cross-region log backups. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域日志备份的保存时间，单位：天
parameters.name: cross_region_log_backup_retention

parameters.help_en: The CrossRegionFilterValue
parameters.help_zh: The CrossRegionFilterValue
parameters.name: cross_region_filter_value

Message.description_en: The response message. "success" is returned if the request is successful. Otherwise, the corresponding error code is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息，成功返回success，错误返回对应错误码

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
